# International Journal of Advanced Engineering Research and Science (IJAERS)

> A peer-reviewed, open-access multidisciplinary engineering journal with global indexing across Qualis, CNKI, CrossRef, Google Scholar, Scopus, and Redalyc.

IJAERS is an internationally recognized engineering research publication that maintains rigorous double-blind peer review standards and publishes research across artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and advanced engineering disciplines. The journal is indexed by major academic databases and recognized by Brazil's Ministry of Education.

## Key Topics

- Peer-reviewed journal
- Open-access publishing
- Engineering research
- Qualis-CAPES indexing

- CrossRef indexing

- Artificial intelligence
- Multidisciplinary scope
